protocol.status: Locally timestamped specification recorded before downloading or inspecting the external price panel. Not an independently registered preregistration, prospective experiment, or statistically independent sample.
protocol.external_universe: Eight US-listed iShares country equity ETFs: Australia, Canada, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, Switzerland, France and United Kingdom. Fixed geographical spread among long-established developed-market funds; no outcome-based additions or removals.
protocol.alignment: All requested assets required; finite positive adjusted closes on the supplied trading-date panel; no imputation, ticker replacement or post-result universe changes.
protocol.fractional_model: Unchanged refined_fractional.py rolling_refinement, including all earlier benchmarks and ablations; original grids, windows and horizon-aware selection.
protocol.additional_forecaster: Exactly 0.5 times persistent_asymmetric variance plus 0.5 times gjr_garch variance at every origin/asset/horizon. No learned or retrospectively selected weights. Optional forecast ensemble, not a new fractional variance recurrence.
protocol.figarch: arch 7.2.0 ZeroMean, Normal, FIGARCH(1,d,1), power 2, truncation 1000; standardized centered returns using the common origin-fitted mean and scale. Fit on preceding 1008 returns at original refits; default initial estimates, SLSQP maxiter1000 ftol1e-9. Preserve fitting backcast while updating with observed residuals between refits. Report finite nonconverged fits; abort nonfinite results; no substitution.
protocol.evaluation: Same complete 1/5/21-session targets, every 5 observed sessions on grid starting at price position252; from 2023-01-01; minimum21 sessions between refits. Refit at25-session intervals on this grid. Primary normalized QLIKE, secondary normalized squared error. Annual and per-asset summaries retained.
protocol.comparison: Standalone fractional and fixed ensemble against all references; paired circular block bootstrap 2000 replicates, seed1729, blocks5/10 origins, whole asset vectors resampled together. Nominal intervals, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims.
protocol.development_analysis: Append the same fixed ensemble and FIGARCH to the recorded US index/sector forecasts. These remain exploratory reused-history results, reported separately from external-universe replication.
protocol.stopping_rule: One external evaluation of this fixed specification; report all results regardless of sign. No retuning from external losses. Any subsequently necessary bug fix must be disclosed separately; never silently rewrite this record.
protocol.limitations: Country ETFs share trading hours, currency and global shocks with US assets. Historical prices are retrospectively adjusted, not point-in-time. Universe selection is deliberate, not random. External results are not a prospective trading test.

amendment.reason: The first run completed unchanged fractional forecasts but failed at the first FIGARCH forecast because arch 7.2.0 requires C-contiguous residual arrays. A panel column is a strided array. No FIGARCH comparison results were produced or inspected before this correction.
amendment.changes: Copy fit and forecast residuals to C-contiguous float arrays; make the runner validate and record this amendment. Add a regression test using strided panel columns. No model, parameter grid, benchmark, universe, score or evaluation dates change.
amendment.validation: Four focused tests pass after the correction, including library forecast equivalence on strided panel inputs. The earlier complete suite passed 53 tests before this correction.

protocol.status: Exploratory retrospective study; all available historical periods have been inspected in earlier research. No untouched-test or prospective claim.
protocol.model: Normalized finite fractional-integral weights on squared standardized return innovations; implicit graph diffusion; positive intercept and feedback below one.
protocol.parameter_selection: Equal-weight mean of 1/5/21-session normalized validation QLIKE, using all daily validation origins with complete 21-session targets. 252 trailing observations. Nuisance parameters fitted strictly before validation.
protocol.primary_score: Normalized QLIKE against summed squared returns centered at the common origin-fitted mean; compare all methods on identical origins.
protocol.inference: Paired circular block bootstrap 2000 replicates, blocks 5 and 10 origins, entire asset panel resampled together; nominal intervals, no family-wise significance claim.
protocol.mean_scope: Risk/variance forecasts; no claim of directional price-prediction improvement.
protocol.revision: Persistent asymmetric fractional diffusion; exploratory follow-up after inspecting the first study.
protocol.innovation_assumption: Conditionally symmetric unit-variance shocks for asymmetric expected-moment recursions.
protocol.initialization: Unit standardized variance and unit presample transformed squared innovations.
protocol.gjr: Independent Gaussian QMLE; omega>0, alpha,beta,gamma>=0; alpha+beta+gamma/2<.999; two fixed starts.
